descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S22 Badge control on phone widths and WebKit: tappable, not covered or clipped

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)
  • U3 The manual add form has the three-state toggle (New Admission / Follow-up / Consult) at creation, it defaults to Follow-up, and the state chosen there (or left untouched) is the one saved (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2; TFA-92584 AC 3)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Visual lane profiles Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When Load the chart header and add-form screens

Then The Admission status control is at least 24 px (WCAG 2.5.8) and ideally 44 pt; badge text is not covered or truncated; the add-form toggle is visible without sideways scroll

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): visual-checks.ts tap / covered / truncated / overflow findings on the status select (it matches the select element); findings are evidence for a human

Where it ran: dev; test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
